Tea Ceremony & Planning

Should guests receive an explanation?

For mixed or international weddings, a short explanation helps guests understand the meaning without interrupting the event.

DirectoryWhy explanation helpsKeep the wording short

Why explanation helps

Guests can appreciate the ritual more when they understand what is happening. This is especially useful when families, languages, or cultural backgrounds are mixed.

Keep the wording short

Use one or two clear sentences. The explanation should support the ceremony, not turn it into a lecture.
